stories.headline: Bezos predicts families may need only one earner
stories.summary: Jeff Bezos told Fox News AI productivity will let many households drop a second job, reshaping labor markets and consumer spending.
stories.quote: Because of the productivity in the economy, many people are going to decide, let’s say you have a two-earner income household," he said.

stories.headline: Bezos says AI bubble is hard to gauge
stories.summary: In an interview Bezos admitted uncertainty about an AI bubble but affirmed the technology’s reality, signaling cautious optimism for investors.
stories.quote: "It's hard to know," Bezos said in an interview on Oct. 7. "What I do know is the technology is real."

sources.title: ‘Hard to Know If We’re in an AI Bubble’ Jeff Bezos Says, But Should a Retiree Buy AI Stocks? — ‘I Would Usually Tell a Retiree to Buy the S&P 500’

stories.headline: Bezos shares personal stress‑management tip
stories.summary: Bezos explained his method for handling stress: identify the cause, listen to his body, and collaborate with allies to turn pressure into enjoyment.
stories.quote: “If I’m stressed about something, I’m trying to figure out why [I am] stressed,” Bezos said.

sources.title: Jeff Bezos says the fix for stress is to stop avoiding the problem | Fortune

stories.headline: Woodward criticizes Bezos over Washington Post changes
stories.summary: Bob Woodward argues Bezos has compromised the Post’s independent journalism by cutting staff and aligning editorial tone with political interests.
stories.quote: Bezos has been “compromising public trust in The Washington Post’s aggressive and independent journalism” in deference to Trump.

sources.title: Bob Woodward thought Jeff Bezos had his back. Now he feels disillusioned.

stories.headline: Bezos linked to record‑breaking Miami property purchase
stories.summary: A $69.5 million Golden Beach estate may add to Bezos’s $234 million real‑estate holdings, highlighting his expanding personal asset base.
stories.quote: If Bezos is confirmed as the buyer, the Golden Beach acquisition would add to his existing $234 million real estate portfolio on the heavily guarded Indian Creek Island.

sources.title: Jeff Bezos is rumored to have broken a new real estate record in Miami | Fox Business
